product: Load Unity Catalog tables into PyTorch on AI Runtime (Beta)
tagline: UCDataset streams rows from Unity Catalog tables directly into PyTorch training loops on AI Runtime, without Spark or a SQL warehouse.
what_it_does: UCDataset streams rows from Unity Catalog tables directly into PyTorch training loops on AI Runtime, without Spark or a SQL warehouse. It applies filter expressions and deletion vectors as it reads, and splits the matching rows across GPUs and data loader workers. Beta This feature is in Beta.
why_it_matters: With DDP, the rank with the extra batch then waits on a gradient all reduce that the other ranks never join, and the job fails.
